verdict: Yes. Kabira Handmade from Jaipur pitched healthy edible oils, dairy, spices and flour on Shark Tank India Season 1, but didn't get a deal. Cold-pressed oils, stone-ground flour and pure spices appeal to buyers worried about adulteration.
angle: Cold-pressed oils and stone-ground atta are growing categories. Traceable sourcing and lab tests build trust. Subscriptions help repeat sales.
